answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 38634 Country: India Title: I wanted to know whether teeth implant is allowed as per Shariah Question: I wanted to know whether teeth implant is allowed as per Shariah. I had an accident in which I lost my front six teeth. Doctor has recommended tooth implant to replace the lost teeth, so please guide me whether it is allowed as per Shariah. Answer ID: 38634 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 926/760/B=1433) Yes, you can implant the teeth, it is allowed as per the Shariah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
